name: Elie Saab
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $1375 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Beaded and embroidered evening gowns, cocktail dresses and day ready-to-wear, gowns roughly $5,000–$19,000, plus haute couture and bridal by appointment.
origin: Founded in Beirut, Lebanon in 1982 by Elie Saab.

quote.q: When a celebrity chooses to wear a dress of mine, this means she's choosing my vision of a woman.
quote.src: The National (Abu Dhabi), "A vision of woman"

opview: “When a celebrity chooses to wear a dress of mine, this means she's choosing my vision of a woman.” — Elie Saab, founder, The National (Abu Dhabi), "A vision of woman"

facts_read.source: brand site (About, show pages, boutiques, terms); FHCM house page; saksfifthavenue.com; The National 2010; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Elie Saab Ready-to-Wear and Accessories (shoes); EXCLUDED: Haute Couture (408), Bridal (93), Kids (50), 'Look' placeholder products priced 9,999, long gowns, bags, scarves, jewellery

doors.note: US: 1 own door, 860 Madison Avenue NYC (flagship; RTW, bridal, kids). World: 19 ELIE SAAB-named entries in the feed; the flagship carousel shows 11 cities. Other 27 US rows are resellers — Bergdorf Goodman and Neiman Marcus Bridal Salons are listed as resellers, not as Elie Saab concessions, so concessions = 0. All 27 in return_stockists.csv. Brand mark is ELIE SAAB.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 442 styles (460 RTW listings in /collections/ready-to-wear-all/products.json; style = model number in the handle code + title, so one

craft_evidence.owned: claim with third-party record — a Beirut workshop opened 1982 (15 staff) and Beirut Down Town headquarters from 2005 with couture production and ~220 staff, per a WIPO IP-Advantage case study; nothing
craft_evidence.makers: no — no PDP names a maker
craft_evidence.madein: ~22% (18 of 80 sampled PDPs state 'Made in Italy': leather, outerwear, knit, denim; none of 37 dresses)
craft_evidence.heritage: not on the brand's own site; dated and placed in third-party record (Beirut, 1982)
craft_evidence.process: no — the site carries show pages and an event page, no making content
craft_evidence.reasoning: An owned Beirut atelier is on record (WIPO case study: workshop from 1982, couture production at the Beirut headquarters), but it makes couture, not the ready-to-wear sold on the US store. That ready-to-wear names no maker or mill and states 'Made in Italy' on about a fifth of pages. Between 2 and 4; filed as 3 pending a ruling on whether couture making counts for an RTW row.
